note: Le salon des grands-parents (s02maison redesign 2026-10-22): first-floor parlour, olive damask wallpaper, dark wainscot, Persian rug on oak boards; LANDMARK white carved-stone fireplace with the gilt family-tree painting above and grandpa's green wing chair beside it; bay window with window seat on the east wall (garden trees). Feminine left: granny wrapping a boy in bandages like a mummy (mamie), little girl holding up a fish fillet on a fork (fillette), barefoot girl looking at her two scraped knees (nièce). Masculine right: grandpa in the wing chair hugging a puppy (papi), small boy at the back turning his back on a bowl of broccoli (neveu), father pushing a pram with a green parrot on his shoulder (parent), young man with a big white gander under his arm (gendre), little boy in a red fez (petit-fils), twins on the rug each hugging a toy elephant (jumeau), dapper short man with a bow tie holding up a pear (beau-père). Open door on the left wall shows the sage dressing room with its tall wardrobe (R_wardrobe_02). Zoom on the mantel photographs -> R_family_02_z1; zoom on the family-tree painting -> R_family_02_z2.
